title.narrative: Denmark's core contributions to the International Organization for Migration (IOM) 2023-2026

description.narrative:
IOM is the leading inter-governmental organization in the field of migration. IOM works to help ensure the orderly and humane management of migration, to promote international cooperation on migration issues, to assist in the search for practical solutions to migration problems and to provide humanitarian assistance to migrants in need by providing services and advice to governments and migrants as well as working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners. IOM works to address humanitarian, development and human mobility challenges.
The project concerns Danish core funding under the Strategy for the partnership between Denmark and the IOM 2023-2026. The Strategy outlines the overall priorities for Denmark’s contributions to and partnership with IOM, and is the central platform for Denmark’s dialogue the organization. The priorities for Denmark’s partnership with IOM are firmly rooted in the UN Agenda 2030, the Danish strategy for development cooperation, “The World We Share” (2021) as well as the Danish Foreign and Security Policy Strategy (2022). This particularly concerns priorities related to addressing poverty, fragility and conflict, as well as addressing irregular migration and helping more people better along the migratory routes.
The four priority areas for Danish support spanning both core and softly earmarked contributions to IOM during the period 2023-2026 are:
1. Enhanced strategic and organizational effectiveness of IOM, 2. Development of IOM’s role in the UN System and partnerships, 3. Supporting capacity building of governments and relevant authorities for better migration management, 4. Addressing the linkage between climate change and irregular migration and forced displacement.
IOM annual reporting can be accessed at https://www.iom.int/iom-annual-reports. Indicator reporting can be accessed at https://www.srf.iom.int/objectives.

The objective of Denmark’s support to IOM is to strengthen orderly and humane migration management, addressing the drivers of irregular migration, including climate change, and to strengthen international and UN coordination and cooperation in this regard.
